artboards.title: Warden landing · dark, live Beacon hero

annotations.text:
Hero = a mini Beacon opened on survival-main.
• Sidebar: every instance section is navigable (Console, Metrics, Players, Properties, Files, Access, Plugins, Backups, Settings); the instance switcher cycles Paper / Purpur / Fabric (Plugins hides on Fabric).
• Header: Stop / Restart / Start, resource tiles with live sparklines.
• Console feeds lines over time and answers the command chips; right aside mirrors the real one (Status, Players, Server).
All data is dummy.
